subject.title: Add daily cost and plan usage history for OpenCode Go

question: Should OpenCode Go Auto mode combine web quota windows with device-local `opencode.db` cost history while explicit Web-only mode intentionally omits the cost chart?
rationale: This is a user-visible change to the meaning of the existing source modes, not only a mechanical rendering fix; tests can verify implementation but cannot select the desired product contract.

options.title: Approve hybrid Auto mode
options.body: Keep web quota windows plus best-effort local daily costs in Auto mode, retain Web-only as a strict no-local-read mode, and require the requested live proof.

options.title: Keep local costs fallback-only
options.body: Restrict daily cost history to the local fallback path so a successful Auto web fetch preserves current source semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve hybrid Auto mode
recommendation.body: Keep web quota windows plus best-effort local daily costs in Auto mode, retain Web-only as a strict no-local-read mode, and require the requested live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider-source semantics and menu UX rather than a narrow parser detail.
